newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi's Riyad Bank assigned highest rating.
newsitem.headline: Saudi's Riyad Bank assigned highest rating.

text.p: Riyad Bank, Saudi Arabia's second biggest, said on Thursday it had been assigned highest rating by the U.S.-based credit rating agency, Thomson Bankwatch.
Bankwatch awarded it highest intra country rating of IC-A and local currency rating of LC-1 on the basis of the bank's strong balance sheet, large capital base and "excellent asset quality".
IC (Intra Country) ratings provide an assessment of the bank's financial position and performance and its ability to meet obligations.

LC (Local Currency) ratings apply to unsubordinated instruments of the rated entity with an original maturity of one year or less, including deposits, bankers' acceptances, letters of credit and other obligations.
